headline: Real estate prices in Croatia rose 12.7 percent
summary: The State Statistical Office reported that residential property prices in the second quarter were on average 12.7% higher than in the second quarter of 2025. The data were released on Thursday.
why: Residential property prices reflect housing demand, credit conditions and construction costs, and they influence household wealth and the banking sector's mortgage exposure.
